content: Essential data pipelines for this trading bot: (1) STOCK Act disclosures via House CSV dumps or Quiver Quantitative API — must use filing date not transaction date to avoid look-ahead bias; (2) EDGAR Form 4 via EFTS with 10 req/sec rate limit, filtering to transaction code P (open market purchases) only; (3) FRED macro via vintage-data API with realtime_start parameter to avoid retroactive revisions; (4) yfinance prices downloaded and snapshotted immutably since adjusted prices are retroactively recalculated. Each pipeline is independent and converges at the composite scorer.
